mentions.quote: The abandoned Delaware, Lackawanna & Western terminal (background, Figure 4-5) now owned by the City of Buffalo was studied because it was felt that costly private property takings and relocations could be avoided, resulting in overall cost savings and minimizing the loss of taxable properties.
